site.name: Marrow Point Bakery
site.description: A wholesale bakery. It bakes the breads and mixes the glazes that other kitchens put on their menus, and it publishes an agent network that describes them.

networks.name: marrow_point
networks.description: Describes Marrow Point's breads, buns and glazes and the ingredients the bakery publishes for them.

llm_router.note: Informational only. A caller that loads this network runs it on the caller's own active router, with the caller's own model policy and key. This bakery never receives a caller's credential and this block must not replace a caller's inference path.

//allowed_peers: The only place this site's allow-list lives. It was published twice — here and nested under peer_policy — which is two stories in one document, so a reader consulting the nested block saw something different from what the runtime reads. Harmless only while both were empty. The deli's manifest had the same defect and lost it first; this one kept it because the test that forbids it read only the deli. tests/artifacts.test.ts now reads both.
